title: After approve, next_action names check --commit, and review and ship refuse a verification commit that lacks the change's work
description: After approve, next_action names check --commit, and review and ship refuse a verification commit that lacks the change's work
acceptance_criteria: After approve, status and show name specsync change check <id> --commit. change review and change ship refuse when the verification commit does not contain the change's work, and do not bind a review to a commit that lacks that work.

answers.constraints: src/commands/change.rs is owned solely by cmd_change, so this change declares that module. cmd_change already delegates next_action policy to the change module; this change does not add a cmd_change requirement.
